name: Message
summary: Present caller-updated conversation content with compact actions, source disclosure and follow-up callbacks.

useWhen: Present caller-updated conversation content with compact actions, source disclosure and follow-up callbacks.
avoidWhen: Executing remote tasks, managing backend state or simulating assistant processing.

obligations: sourcesExpanded/onSourcesExpandedChange or defaultSourcesExpanded control the source disclosure. Follow-up records use id/label; their buttons render only when onFollowUp exists and report the chosen record without auto-sending.

streaming is caller-owned. A polite atomic region announces streamingLabel independently of content updates; tokens are not live-announced. There is no timer, fake response, focus theft, auto-scroll or remote request.

behavior: The native article host/ref, children and HTML attributes/events retain their native meanings. sender is user, assistant or system rather than redefining native role; author is React content rather than native title or RDFa content.

Caller-updated ReactNode children render first, followed by compact labeled actions and source disclosure, then follow-up controls. Markdown is explicitly composed through separately imported @muxui/react/markdown; the root imports no parser or editor.

Actions use id/label/icon/onAction/disabled/pressed records. Decorative icons never supply the accessible name. Sources use id/label/href/description records; HTTP(S) and relative links are admitted, unsafe schemes/control characters are presented as unlinked labels.

sourcesExpanded/onSourcesExpandedChange or defaultSourcesExpanded control the source disclosure. Follow-up records use id/label; their buttons render only when onFollowUp exists and report the chosen record without auto-sending.

streaming is caller-owned. A polite atomic region announces streamingLabel independently of content updates; tokens are not live-announced. There is no timer, fake response, focus theft, auto-scroll or remote request.
accessibility: Preserve native host/ref/events and keyboard controls with visible focus.
Use semantic labels and static status announcements; do not rely on color or continuously animated processing.

requirements.reason: Native dynamic colors do not apply to the React web binding.
Native font metrics do not apply to the React web binding.
